We are excited to announce an exclusive reward opportunity for all players of MU Legend: EVO! Whether you're a seasoned warrior or a new adventurer, you're welcome to redeem this limited-time code and enjoy fantastic in-game rewards that will enhance your journey and strengthen your battles.

notes.title: Dark Lord
notes.content:
Dark Lord, once notorious on the MU continent, is very suitable for leading the battle at the front line after they are equipped with shields with extraordinary defense ability. They are committed to liberating mankind from darkness. In order to gain great power, they sacrificed their humanity. 

The Dark Lord uses scepters and shields to cast recovery and support skills, and he has played an important role in improving all aspects of combat effectiveness. In addition, in order to maximize their damage ability, they can also give up their shields and use two-handed weapons. This allows the Dark Lord to raid the battlefield with powerful regional attacks and group control. 

[b]Dark Lord can help players defeat the enemy in fierce battles. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/25cf84fe9ab5eeffa158076a3174dc2332f8a704.png[/img]
 
The Dark Lord uses a scepter and shield to command the battlefield. He leads the front-line operations with overwhelming defense ability and has various recovery and support skills, which can improve the combat effectiveness of the players. 

He can also use two-handed weapons by giving up his shield, giving him strong regional attack ability and group control skills. Although he is mainly used as a tank, his destructive power-handling skills cannot be ignored. 
 
[b]Battlefield commander and world guardian[/b]

The Dark Lord is an important figure in the team. He is good at attracting enemies and resisting attacks, and he easily plays the role of a tank. He overpowered the enemy with his scepter and shield, so if the tank is your first choice, then Dark Lord is your best choice. 

The Dark Lord doesn't have many attacks to make him charge. But he has a high HP and can attack the enemy from a distance or get closer to the enemy without being easily killed. He has the highest HP and defense ability among all the classes of MU Legend and is the main tank class that can cooperate with other classes. Remember, this class is more suitable for playing team games in dungeons than single-player games. 

His mobility is not very good, but he has many skills that are useful in to the team. He can restore HP for himself and his players and can temporarily protect them through defensive skills. He can become temporarily invincible and eliminate the negative buff of the players, making him a valuable asset in the battle. 

The Dark Lord is the strongest warrior in Mu Legend. 

Although Dark Lord is a melee fighter with relatively low mobility, his auxiliary skills have proved his value. This skill is very useful in fighting the replica BOSS, which can improve the abilities of the players. He also has the ability to slow down the movement speed of multiple enemies and can attack many monsters at the same time. 

The Dark Lord can use a one-handed scepter and shield, or a two-handed weapon. Maces and shields are very useful when used as tanks in dungeons, while two-handed weapons can be used alone in games or hunting. 

When equipped with two-handed weapons, a certain amount of defense will be converted into attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/618800daa422e8eab121cad40f7c5b524066ee93.jpg[/img]
Dark Lord uses a scepter and shield (left) and a two-handed weapon (right).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/fd5974575ed8fe85a418da03c6540bf614506808.jpg[/img]
Great! Deal a lot of damage with two-handed weapons. 

[b]Skill information: buff, debuff and mocking[/b]

[b]Weapon skills: Reduce enemy speed and improve attributes through multiple combos. [/b] 
 
One-handed weapon skills include "Destructive Call", "Powerful Explosion" and "Shield Punch". Successful shield blocking will generate shock waves and cause additional damage. 

Two-handed weapon skills include "whirlwind strike", "sacred strike" and "tenacious March". Using two-handed weapons can enhance the attack power. 

"Destructive Call" is a basic close-range scepter attack. However, the third hit will generate anger, and the "powerful explosion" will stab the enemy and give him a chance to do more harm. In addition, the "Shield Punch" will cause damage to the surrounding enemies in on the third strike. 

The "Whirlwind strike" of two-handed weapons throws cyclones forward and increases the number of cyclones and the damage caused when they are used many times. "Holy Strike" sends a powerful blow to the front and reduces the moving speed and defense of the target. Finally, the "Tenacious March" caused AOE damage to the enemy in front and dragged it to the side. When attacking continuously, the pulling area and damage will increase. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/762e5624a5d1c890437a6375b9cd2367ecb2c270.png[/img]
Comparison between scepter and two-handed weapon. 

[b]Comparison between scepter and two-handed weapon. [/b]
 
You can use the "Flame Blunt" to cause AOE damage at the beginning of the battle, because the area touched by the fiery chain of the Dark Lord is ignited and causes continuous damage. With "Spin Attack", you can spin quickly to hit nearby enemies, slow them down, and increase hatred. 

"Guardian Touch" can temporarily silence the enemy and restore the HP of allies. "Flame Burst" is a powerful AOE attack which that will cause additional area damage after 1.5 seconds. "Thunder Call" allows you to attack enemies around you and push them away from you. 

The "Eternal Flame" creates a whirlwind that lasts for 20 seconds, causing continuous damage without attacking all enemies one by one. "Holy Light" can restore HP for yourself and your allies around you and reduce mana consumption. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/5c5ab6b67f2550bf97efc97682d4e2139829e537.jpg[/img]
"Fire Burst" is a powerful AOE attack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/5ba475ea374e745e3a9f663914c9fef1dee7e1d4.jpg[/img]
"Thunder Call" enables you to attack and push the enemy. 

"Speed Charge" is the only charge attack of the Dark Lord. It causes AOE damage and mocking, forcing your enemies to attack you for 2.5 seconds, which is considered as the basic effect of team games. "Monarch Touch" throws a hook forward and causes AOE damage, pulling and mocking the enemy.

 These are the two most valuable skills in team games. In addition to these skills, "crampons" can also freeze nearby enemies, while "weapon throwing" can cause damage and stun in a wide range. 

However, there are more skills that are useful in team games. "Purification" can eliminate all abnormal states of yourself and your allies around you. 

"Rugard Protection" has created a huge shield that can improve its defense for 10 seconds. Finally, the greatest skill of the Dark Lord is "Destroying Tremor", which is an a charging skill. The longer the charging time, the greater the damage. The affected enemy will slow down the movement speed by 4 seconds, so that you can deal with the enemy more effectively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/a8bcb0ddfbdf8a03768114aa233c4ca7ab348b45.jpg[/img]
"Purification" cleared party member's abnormal state
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/24ff3d8d9a9b76826f13188b5128cf9ae1d4bd52.jpg[/img]
"Rugard protection" enhanced the defense ability. 

Expert skills: Use both attack and defense skills. 
 
Choose expert skills from strategy, immunity, destruction, encouragement, withering, and attack. "Strategy" has the passive skill of "simulation", which can increase hatred, and you can also use "Berserker absorption" to immediately draw around enemies and cause range damage while providing yourself with a shield. 

Immunity enables you to use Pain Immunization. This can immunize all incoming damage for 4 seconds, which is a good survival skill. You will also gain the passivity of "Surpassing Shield", increase the shield blocking rate by 10%, and restore HP after successful blocking. 

The "Withering" expert skill enables you to use the "Follower's Spirit", which is an on/off skill that can summon the soul of an attacking enemy in a designated area. It also has "Brave passion" passivity. When the main weapon skill is used, this skill will reduce the defense of the target for by 5 seconds.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/dc026cdc0b84e66ce06515c1f0d3feca867ee366.png[/img]
Dark Lord can use 6 expert skills. 

"Encouragement" is a very useful expert skill for the Dark Lord. It gives the "Defender's Shield" passive skill, which can increase the defense ability of players within 20 meters. Similarly, the "Dark Horse" skill will generate dark energy, increase movement speed by 40%, and make all damage gain 30% immunity while ignoring collisions. 

There is also a perfect expert skill when you need to attack a large number of enemies. The "Destroy" expert skill can destroy many enemies in a large area, causing great damage, so that you can use the "Rugard's Wrath", a skill to summon Rugard's statue to a specified location. "Rugard's Wrath" is a skill that you must master. In addition, when you attack, the passive "guardian authority" gives a 10% increase in attack power for 5 seconds. Aggressive Dark Lords are strongly recommended to use this skill. 

The final expert skill, "attack" encourages your teammates to attack the enemy fearlessly. It enables you to use the "attack command" to improve the attack, movement speed, attack speed and critical strike rate of team members. The Dark Lord will need this skill.

notes.title: Blader
notes.content:
Blader is the fiercest warrior in MU Legend, and he is good at destroying the enemy quickly and cruelly. Because of his anger and great power, he can play the role of melee damage and tank at the same time. 

If you like exciting battles, then Blader is the best class for you. Whether it is a sword with one hand or a broadsword with two hands, he can fight with great strength on the battlefield, which is a class that anyone can easily use. 

[b]Blader has a strong charge and melee attack[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/4a5b562294db6f2307f4872bacf5aa832077d17a.png[/img]

A fierce warrior who can easily break through the enemy

Blader fought hard on the battlefield and played a decisive role with its powerful attack power. He is not only a powerful attacker; his high defensive ability means that he is an excellent all-round fighter who can cope with all kinds of situations. 

He used charge skills to quickly close the distance and used crowd control to lure the enemy. High mobility enables him to serve as both a melee fighter and a front tank, and participate in the battle fearlessly to destroy the enemy and cause chaos. 

His notoriously huge physique enabled him to rampage among many enemies through bloodthirsty aggression. 

He has the biggest attack power in all classes of MU Legend, and is a top melee class, which is very effective in teams, personal games, dungeons, and anywhere else! 

He also has various crowd control skills, so if you can use them effectively, you will be able to fight against multiple enemies in a relatively safe situation. His reliable defense can restore HP when attacking, which makes him an excellent tank which who can take the lead in fighting and defeat the enemies on the front line. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/5dc1c148a35e6ebd2eb2e13120ec0b1c1088bbfb.jpg[/img]
Blader has a powerful melee attack

Blader is a melee class, but his long-range skills also make him good at long-range hunting. His high mobility can quickly complete the dungeon, and because he can charge the enemy in an instant, he is also good at dealing with remote enemies. 

A blader can use a one-handed sword or a two-handed broadsword. You can choose your favorite weapon. A one-handed sword can be waved with two hands (one in each hand), so it can further improve your combat effectiveness. 

Although the two-handed broadsword is slow, its wide range and powerful attack ability enable it to make a powerful blow. The one-handed sword with both hands has a special effect, which can make the weapon absorb HP, while the broadsword has an additional attack power enhancement option, which can cause more damage. 

If speed is important to you, I suggest you use a sword. On the other hand, if you need more strength, please use a broadsword. Therefore, whether you want to fight the enemy on the front line or just to hunt more effectively, Blader is an excellent all-round class with everything you need. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/50244dd7f68f47a4633d98b139ff9875a34fcd1a.jpg[/img]
Blader can use one-handed sword (left) or two-handed broadsword (right)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/620167161c1f72a19ac7af03d8bed829b1f7ffb3.jpg[/img]
Two-handed broadsword has excellent attack power

[b]Skill information: Restore HP or enhance attack power[/b]

Weapon skills: enhanced attack ability and HP. 

The weapon skills of a one-handed sword are "split", "slash" and "attack", as well as HP recovery. A two-handed broadsword has the weapon skills of "split attack", "sweep" and "smash", which can also enhance the attack power. 

"Split" uses a one-handed sword to cut everything in front. Although its scope is narrower than that of a two-handed broadsword, its scope of action is quite good for fencing. In addition, the "slash" will stab the enemy, and every three hits will cause more damage. Similarly, the "attack" caused more damage in the fourth hit. 

The two-handed broadsword skill "split attack" has a large attack range and HP absorption function, which can increase the chances of survival when hunting. The higher the damage caused by the attack, the higher the HP you can recover, so it is important to increase the attack attribute. "Sweep" does great damage to the third strike, while "Smash" will make the enemy bleed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/8c1e00ff40f54ad76d60292700b467d53c0641b9.png[/img]
Sword and giant sword have different passive effects

Class skills: charge and kill the enemy. 

You can use "Smash" to cause AoE damage to the front, and quickly rotate to attack the enemy with Blader's signature skill, "Blade Whirlwind". "Blade Whirlwind" is a charging skill. Just press the shortcut key to activate it, and when activated, it can improve the moving speed. 

Blader has many abnormal state skills, such as "Rage", and has a powerful attack ability which that can blow the enemy away and make him unconscious (this powerful skill will cause two abnormal states). "Rambling" is a very useful attack which that can launch a series of blows to the front and make the enemy unconscious immediately. 

Blader is a melee class, so repelling is not as useful as stunning. However, when there are many enemies in the way, you can use repelling to open the way.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/5d20e7610085a4ffe77ca8dc5ea46c9cfce367bc.jpg[/img]
The iconic group attack "Sword whirlwind"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/c02c796f48596eab8d8c5fffb3d45a194594e530.jpg[/img]
"Rage" caused an abnormal state twice in a row.

In the "jump attack", you have valuable charge skills and can move quickly in the battle. Perform a violent jump, then land and cause damage. However, the real benefit of using this skill is that it allows you to skip the enemy and escape if necessary. Similarly, "dash" allows you to Brust directly to the selected location, defeat the hit enemy, and get you out of trouble. 

Compared with other skills, "impact" will only make you move a short distance. This kind of attack is unique in that it consumes HP to attack. The damage caused is equal to the HP consumed, so the more HP, the greater the power of the attack. 

"Majestic Roar" is a skill that causes damage and reduces the attack power of nearby enemies, and "clanging roar" can increase the attack speed of teammates and exert fear on enemies. "Rescue" enables you to avoid all attacks in a short time, thus escaping danger. 

"Last effort" can improve the attack power and create a shield that absorbs damage, and "triple strike" can improve the damage and attack speed of weapons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/73c2065043bd0b2e55f54a44c1b3d9e91599bf53.jpg[/img]
Use "Jump Attack" to move

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/8587cfb6cb058cbd3de53065cf47e2aa698957d9.jpg[/img]
"Last effort" is a great BUFF skill

Class skills: improve attack, defense and speed. 

For class skills, you can choose from "Power", "fear", "Spill", "Rage", "Brawling" and "breakthrough". 

First of all, the "Power" use of "steel armor" can reduce all the damage in a certain period of time, and with passive skills, it can increase evasion and HP. 

In addition, "Fear" has a passive effect. When HP is below 50%, you will get more attacks, and you can use "roar" to do harm to the enemy and cause fear. At this point, "Roar" will also cause 50% additional damage to the enemy, which will bring good strength to your attack. 

With Spill, you can change the terrain to defeat the enemy. If there are more than five enemies, your attack intensity will increase. "Gravity deflection" will slam the ground and cause great damage to the targets within the target range, blow the enemy into the air, and cause more damage when they land.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/792ef0fa84a2082a2b9b19136aa5e331606cd5da.png[/img] 
Blader's six class skills

When using weapon skills to strike, "fanaticism" can increase the attack speed, thus achieving a fast-paced battle. The "anger of reversal" instantly magnified Blader, thus greatly increasing the maximum HP. In this state, you will also restore the extra MP. 

"Brawling" has a passive effect, which can reduce the damage after the first blow and make your defense more solid. "Scan" will rotate the weapon as you move forward, and you can get invincible effects when you rotate. 

Finally, when using the "Jump Attack" and "Breakthrough" skills, "Breakthrough" can improve the moving speed, which is very useful when exploring dungeons. "Infinite Charge" reduces the cooling time of "Jump Attack" and "Brust" by 50% for 7 seconds, which brings you great advantages in the battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/1b1a053c1d0cc016701550b8b67c93b1392df3ae.jpg[/img]
"Scan" rotating weapons

notes.title: War Mage
notes.content:
War Mages use powerful Mana power to destroy enemies on the battlefield. Although his defense is very low, his offensive ability is enough to make him an excellent injury damage class. He is flexible enough to deal with all kinds of situations, so he is the most difficult class to master in the MU Legend. 

His staff is mainly used for long-range attacks, and when he uses the magic sword with auxiliary weapons (that is, the magic book), he can carry out melee attacks. It can be used for both short-range injuries and long-range injuries. If you want to use a mixed character with powerful mana power, the War Mage will be very suitable for you. 

War mage is a powerful and effective damage maker. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/4a7a27d6b59bb7a3e3ccc91f0e198b13c8fc8e3b.png[/img]
 
War Mages are very good at long-range AoE and melee attacks, and can deal with single targets and groups at the same time. He can also launch abnormal state attacks, making him an ideal career candidate for strategic combat. 

His HP and defense ability are relatively low, but he has strong group attack ability. You can build your War Mage in many ways, such as a mage with a staff or an assassin with a sword. 

powerful mana power and assassination skills make him unique. 

The War Mage's magic attack is the most elaborate of all classes, and his magic can destroy a wide range of enemies. 

He can be used as a ranged damage dealer or a melee damage dealer, moving as fast as an assassin with a sword that penetrates magic. He has the ability of crowd control and other efficient means of attack, and can respond flexibly to various situations, thus dispatching enemies quickly. 

War Mage is very suitable for those who like to have a radical game style and unique magic attacks in fast-paced battles. Remember, his health and defense are relatively low compared with the attack, so you must pay attention to his survival. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/437bfc61bf1ccb874b25f9c3bdea4e484262ae75.jpg[/img]
The war mage uses powerful mana power to attack. 

The fighting style of the War Mage varies depending on the weapon you choose to equip. Armed with staff will enable him to carry out most ranged attacks, while being equipped with magic swords and auxiliary weapons will produce melee assassin-type characters. This means that the war mage is a mixed character, which can be switched according to your own preferences. 

The staff is a weapon suitable for the mage, allowing him to carry out long-range attacks. He can also use various magic skills from a distance. These long-range attack abilities make him play a role in the team. 

On the other hand, when equipped with a magic sword and a magic book, he becomes a melee type. In this state, he needs to adjust the distance to be able to effectively use remote magic skills. The defense ability of War Mage is weak, so it is necessary to use enhancement and protection skills in melee. 

He is not an easy character to control. When he is equipped with a magic sword, the difficulty will increase. If you want to be a mage, please use a staff, and if you want to make a powerful melee attack, please use a magic sword. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/1869eb376d9c269b800c7e4cdc313b323b889c55.jpg[/img]
A war mage equipped with a staff (left) and a magic sword and magic book (right).  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/eb7552d02e7fbe894e08027a21453058684ad1f8.jpg[/img]
Adds mana power to the magic sword for melee attacks. 

Weapon Skills: Choose your preference, Ranged staff or Melee magic sword. 

The long-range skills of War Mage include Chaos Ball, Energy Explosion and Shock Wave, while the skills of Magic Sword and Magic Book include War Veteran, Marching Blade and Torture Wave. Choosing a long-range staff can make you do more damage to targets over 6 meters, and choosing a magic sword can do more damage to targets within 7 meters. 

The staff skill "Autumn of Chaos" throws a magic sphere as a ranged attack and causes additional AoE damage in the area behind the hit target. "Energy Explosion" is an explosive energy sphere thrown by a war mage, causing AoE damage and causing additional explosion after the enemy is killed. In addition, "Shock Wave" is an impact bomb attack, which causes AoE damage and slows down the enemy's moving speed. 

Magic Sword Skill "War Veteran" uses a sword full of dark energy to slam the enemy, push the enemy and cause a negative effect. Every three attacks will reduce the defense. The "Marching Blade" cuts the sword forward and has the opportunity to ignore 10% of the enemy's defense. The "torture wave" causes AoE damage to the front and extra damage to the target on the third hit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/372e655dcdc6e7a97ca7a7bc1d6b9baae86b99e9.png[/img]
Each weapon will bring you unique advantages. 

Class Skills: Powerful mana power switch between Ice and Fire. 

War mages have powerful mana power attack skills, the first of which is a magic skill called "Hand of Fire". This skill will ignite a fire in one place, causing AoE damage, and constantly causing additional damage while the fire is burning. 

The Light Chain will project a magnetic field. As a continuous skill, use chains to do damage to nearby enemies. The "Flame Wall" causes continuous damage by igniting the ground. It is similar to the "Flame Hand" but more powerful. 

"Horrible Dance" enables you to teleport to the designated place. Once you land, you will kill the enemy, so it is very suitable for the magic sword. If you use the skill again within 2 seconds, you can return to the original position. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/325efef0f7031c27be7ae5348d3d37fb3cf05a2b.jpg[/img]
Press and hold the shortcut key of "Light Chain" to continue projection. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/64cad5805ae74bd55ea32713d9982bf10894d924.jpg[/img]
The magic sword and the magic book match well. 

For battles where the abnormal state will give you an advantage, throw magic fragments to slow down the enemy's movement. You can also use the "Blade Whirlwind" to launch a spinning stun attack on the enemy in front. Use "Bound Blizzard" to summon a huge snowstorm, causing damage to a large area and reducing the speed within the range. 

In addition, "Full Throttle" causes an explosion and sends you forward, while making you invisible. Ghost Shield is a useful survival skill, that which allows you to absorb 40% of the maximum health damage. "Extreme Blink" allows you to jump to a position and attack the enemy from left to right. When it is active, you will be invincible, so it can be used as a survival skill when there is danger. Finally, "Phantom Infection" will pollute an area to cause damage. If the target dies, the infection will spread to another target, and you can recover 25% of the maximum MP. 
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/2a45f3aa466a29441f59912226280ca16ec368f5.jpg[/img]
"Bound Blizzard" summoned an ice storm. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/0b31c024d80e9bc76c9cdbe1552c32793718de02.jpg[/img]
Absorb damage with "Ghost Shield". 

Class skills: Summon demons and create ice storms. 

The six expert skills of War mage are Chaos, Slam, Destroy, Invincibility, Pain and Destruction. Chaos has a passive effect, which will reduce the defense of the enemy within 20 meters. It also allows you to cast "Ghosts", which can summon evil spirits to do continuous damage to nearby enemies. 

"Slam" has a passive effect, which can improve your maximum HP and defense, while "Final Notice" has the skill of powerful attack on the front. If the target's HP is less than 50%, the "Final Notice" may cause additional damage. 

“Destory” "Destroy" has a passive effect on reducing MP consumption. You can also use the "Meteor Falling" skill, which can drop huge meteors at selected locations. Meteor has a powerful attack power, and all enemies hit by it will be pushed away and suffer additional sustained damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/3c44b10eeff7b4bb2e6d2162c6cdb56a78c05cad.png[/img]
Upgrade and learn special skills. 

"Invincibility" is the best survival skill of a War mage, including "Glacier Prison" skill. "Glacier Prison" temporarily wraps the enemy in ice, making you invincible. When breaking the ice, the pieces will cause damage to the surrounding enemies and slow down their movement speed. "Invincibility" also has a passivity. When this skill is cast many times, it causes extra damage. 

"Pain" can increase your attack strength by up to 9% according to the number of enemies around you, and enable you to use the "Cold Sword" skill to cause continuous damage to enemies around you. 

"Destroy" can reduce the cooldown of all skills, or you can use the "Ice Wall" skill to make an ice wall. Damage to the surrounding enemies and freeze them, so this is a powerful abnormal state attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/5079abfa125d0a756fe5f8b71824295ec9346e5f.png[/img] 
"Ice Wall" is a powerful abnormal state attack.

notes.title: Airship Defense
notes.content:
Dungeon Location 

Ordo > Guild Port

notes.title: Whisperer
notes.content:
"Whisperer" is a female class known for its strong ranged lethality. It is the fastest and most rapid-attack class in the game. Her attacks are very effective. Although her defense is weak, she can hunt relatively safely by keeping her distance. She uses a Wing Gun and a longbow, and it is one of her characteristics to carry a Wing Gun in each hand. Due to her mobility, Whisperer can hunt quickly and deal more damage to single targets rather than using AoE attacks. Therefore, if you prefer fast-paced action and powerful ranged attacks, then the "Whisperer" is your best choice. 
 
Whisperers are fast-moving archers with high attack speed.  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/0cf97e7d556f55cce1bc462d63a275f0f7a01b3b.png[/img]
  Whisperer is the fastest moving and attacking class, excelling in ranged damage. She focuses her strength on single targets and minimizes damage through high evasion. As a highly mobile, destructive ranged class, she employs various strategies, including using bows and arrows, smoke bombs, and even the forces of nature. Whisperer moves like the wind, utilizing bows and traps to gain the upper hand on the battlefield. 
 
"Whisperer" is renowned for her swift movements and lethal efficiency, earning the reputation of silently announcing death to her enemies. Compared to other classes, she moves much faster, and her high flexibility combined with powerful bow and arrow attacks make her an excellent ranged damage dealer. Her mobility allows her to traverse various areas quickly, making her especially effective against bosses due to her focus on single-target attacks. While her defense is low, her fast movement and high evasion help her avoid significant damage. 

However, when her movements are restricted, her efficiency decreases. Despite this, she performs well in most areas, making leveling up relatively easy. Whisperers are an excellent choice for players who enjoy high mobility and quick movements.   
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/f887ff596490c03d8bb87ff413c67f7c002c05f9.jpg[/img]
The Whisperer's arrows are very powerful
  You can hunt safely and easily by keeping your distance and taking advantage of her ranged attacks and fast movement. She can use two types of weapons: the Wing Gun and the longbow. Both are ranged weapons, but the Wing Gun is a one-handed weapon, while the longbow is a two-handed weapon. However, the Whisperer carries a Wing Gun in each hand, effectively making it a two-handed weapon. 
 
The Wing Gun has low attack power but fast attack speed. Although its range is short, it is effective for causing AoE damage with counterattacks. The longbow has higher attack power than the Wing Gun and is very effective against single targets at range. In summary, the Wing Gun is more suitable for AoE attacks, while the longbow excels at attacking single targets. 
 
In addition to simple ranged attacks, the Whisperer employs various combat strategies, such as setting traps, causing damage with explosions, or deceiving enemies into hiding with smoke screens.  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/e8de4f081a2a1fc42850591a4d71e75ff58c0857.jpg[/img]
The Long Bow (left) and Wing Gun (right) of the Whisperer
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/78de8a66068454ee4829edb13506bf6a052b59bc.jpg[/img]
Throw a flame with a wing gun 
Skill Info: Shooting, traps, and stealth 
Weapon Skill: Poison and burn enemies.
 
The Whisperer can use "Piercing Arrow," "Poisonous Arrow," or "Multi-Arrow" with the longbow and "Frontal Shot," "Flamethrower," or "Volley" with the wing gun. The longbow increases attack power, while the wing gun boosts the critical strike rate. 
 
"Piercing Arrow" penetrates the enemy and damages multiple foes in its path, with a chance to slow their movement speed. Although "Poisonous Arrow" does less immediate damage, it inflicts poison that continues to harm the enemy over time. "Multi-Arrow" fires several arrows simultaneously, causing area-of-effect (AoE) damage. 
 
"Frontal Shot" uses the wing gun to deliver AoE damage and push enemies back. The "Flamethrower" inflicts continuous damage to enemies in front of the user and has a chance to ignite them, though its range is limited. Lastly, "Volley" is an ultra-fast attack with very low damage output.  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/9c1b221736f7235d0cc17aba86b906adf56f235a.png[/img]
Each weapon offers unique advantages  
Class Skills: Set traps and hide behind the smoke screen. 
 
The Whisperer’s arsenal includes quick attacks such as "Multiple Shots," "Quick Shots," and "Blasting Shots." "Quick Shots" is an energizing skill that consumes MP to shoot a series of arrows at the enemy. "Blasting Shots" is a fan-shaped attack that lasts for 2 seconds; while it’s not energizing, it has a sustained effect. 
 
Additionally, "Electronic Explosion" inflicts an abnormal status and can be used strategically as an initial attack. When this skill hits an enemy, it explodes, causing damage and slowing the enemy’s movement within the affected area. "Cold Shooting" is a powerful skill suited for continuous attacks, ideal for keeping a distance from the enemy. 
 
The "Catcher’s Trap" sets a trap that explodes when triggered, slowing the enemy’s movement speed. "Wild Will" deals significant damage, binds the enemy, and temporarily prevents movement. The "Smoke Screen" deploys smoke bombs at a target location, instantly blinding enemies within range and causing their attacks to miss.  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/21af700daaee4a44850ba873ea545e0e56613379.jpg[/img]
Use "Electronic Explosion" to shock the enemy and slow them down 
 Whisperers have a range of buff and debuff skills to weaken enemies and enhance their own abilities with teammates. "Rolling" boosts attack power. "Combo" summons arrows to a selected area, causing damage and slowing the enemy's attack speed while also reducing the damage you take. "Blast Sprint" increases movement speed by 50% for 8 seconds, ignores collisions, and improves maneuverability. "Naturalization" is a stealth skill that makes you disappear in smoke, improving attack speed and ability while hidden, making it a valuable buff to turn the tide in dangerous situations. 
 
"Sacrifice" leaves a trail of death that explodes after 5 seconds, causing harm. If the target survives, their defense is reduced by 50%, leading to significant damage. "The Holy Land of Grass and Trees" boosts the attack speed of you and your teammates for 10 seconds, providing a useful team buff.  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/a7bae3caedc6ccb04fcbee479df463889c83e2fd.jpg[/img]
"Combo" can execute powerful attacks over a wide area 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/8c554c89ac80424802fa6f192538454381579f49.png[/img]
The number on the "Sacrifice" mark indicates the remaining time 
Class Skills: Trap enemies or summon elements. 
 
Class skills are unlocked as you level up, with options including "Bomb," "Summon," "Absorb," "Chase," "Slow," and "Rampage." Using the "Earth Bless" skill, "Bombing" reduces the defense of all enemies within range by 5%. It also features a "Bomb" skill that throws a tracker into a selected area to summon arrows. Using this skill every 10 times improves MP recovery speed. The "Earth Element" skill summons natural energy. "Absorb" includes a passive skill that increases attack intensity and the ability to summon "Exotic Trees" in chosen areas.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/945683369ff27133d944c8db644b33e030fa1d40.png[/img] 
Which Class skill would you choose 
"Pursuit" will increase your movement speed and allow you to use "Wall of Pain," which summons a circular wall to damage the selected area. The wall stays for 4 seconds, trapping enemies and dealing continuous damage to those inside it. 
 
Whenever you get hurt, "Slow" will enhance your defense and enable the use of "Pain Magnetic Field," allowing you to build new traps. These traps will generate a magnetic field that moves forward through the battlefield, attacking and stunning all enemies in its path. 
 
With "Berserker," you can increase your attack speed when you have more than 90% HP. You can also use "Berserker Power," which enhances your weapons and increases your attack strength by 50% for 5 seconds. This skill can greatly boost your attack power in a short time.   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/476604d9243fd3ff15cbfcb27df602342befc749.jpg[/img]
The "Wall of Pain" is obtained through "Pursuit

notes.title: Introduction to Novice Guide System
notes.content:
As a role-playing game, MU Legend provides novice players with a comprehensive guide system to help them better understand and enjoy the game. The following are some common contents of MU Legend's Novice Guide System. 

1. Role Creation and Guide 

When creating a character, the system provides detailed explanations of options such as class choice and appearance customization. This helps novice players choose the right character according to their own preferences and requests. 

2. The Novice Task 

At the beginning of the game, novice players receive a series of basic tasks designed to help them get familiar with the basic operations, interface, and mechanisms of the game. These tasks are usually easy to understand, and the rewards gained will help novice players grow quickly. 

3. Interface and Function Introduction 

The Novice Guide introduces the main interface and functions of the game in detail, such as backpacks, equipment, skills, and maps, so players can get started quickly. When players obtain an item for the first time, a detailed introduction about the item will appear in the lower right corner of the game. 

4. Combat Guide 

For novice players, combat may be the most challenging part. The Novice Guide teaches players how to launch attacks, use skills, avoid enemy attacks, and other basic knowledge, as well as how to formulate strategies in different combat environments. 

5. Social System Guide 

The social system in the game is very important for novice players. The Novice Guide introduces how to add friends, create or join guilds, and conduct team battles to help players build social networks and enjoy the fun of the game. 

6. Novice Rewards and Benefits 

To encourage novice players to actively participate in the game, MU Legend provides a series of novice rewards and benefits, such as experience bonuses, equipment gifts, and gold coin rewards. These rewards help novice players grow faster and improve their game experience. 

7. Linda's Advanced Training 

After reaching level 70, players can accept Linda's advanced training. In this training, players need to enter different mission areas according to Linda's instructions, complete missions, and receive mission rewards. Linda's training helps novice players become more familiar with the game.

notes.title: Abyss Dungeon - Ancient Ruins
notes.content:
[b]Dungeon Location [/b]

The Ancient Ruins are located at the bottom of Crescent Islands on the mainland of Noria. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/7c87f1e261e8225580761712f866b7ab226cd499.png[/img]
[b]Basic Information [/b]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/ac7b81ff91d3c72d3931c4320b0ae378718aa56d.png[/img]
The Ancient Ruins is the most challenging dungeon in the current version. To enter, players must have a character at level 75 or higher. The dungeon offers four difficulty levels, and each time you enter, the layout may vary. Players can choose the appropriate difficulty level based on their combat effectiveness and that of their team. Higher difficulty levels feature stronger monsters and offer more loot, with a greater variety and higher drop rates. 

Each entry into the Ancient Ruins requires 10 admission tickets. Players can enter the dungeon up to 6 times a day, with the entry count resetting daily at 5:00 a.m. Ancient Ruins admission tickets can be obtained as rewards for Platinum members based on their online time or purchased from the in-game store. 

[b]Dungeon Drops[/b] 

Defeating the boss in the Ancient Ruins rewards players with various items, which differ depending on the dungeon's difficulty level. The higher the difficulty, the more items drop, and the higher their drop rates. The specific drops by difficulty level are as follows: 

- Difficulty 1: Abyss Stone, Fragile Abyss Enhance Stone (used to enhance Legendary Abyss weapons for missions) 

- Difficulty 2: Abyss Stone, Abyss Weapon Embryo 

- Difficulty 3: Abyss Stone, Abyss Weapon Embryo 

- Difficulty 4: Abyss Stone, Abyss Weapon Embryo, Abyss Enhance Stone (used to enhance Abyss weapons for crafting) 

[b]Abyss Weapon Box - For All Classes [/b]

The Abyss Weapon Box is a unique item that can be crafted once your character reaches level 75. There are two ways to craft it: 

1. Combine an Abyss Weapon Embryo with an Abyss Stone and other materials. 

2. Use only Abyss Stones and other materials, but in greater quantities. 

Opening an Abyss Weapon Box grants a random weapon for any class. The weapon’s quality can be Ancient, Myth, or Set.  

- Ancient Abyss Weapons come with 4 main attributes. 

- Myth Abyss Weapons come with 5 main attributes. 

- Set Quality Abyss Weapons come with 6 main attributes. 

Additionally, each Abyss weapon is accompanied by a random passive skill. Players can select an Abyss weapon based on its attributes and passive skill. 

 

To enhance Abyss weapons, you need Bless Gems and Abyss Enhance Stones. Enhancement levels 1-6 require only Bless Gems, while levels 7-15 require both Bless Gems and Abyss Enhance Stones. While the enhancement process does not degrade the weapon, if an enhancement above level 9 fails, the weapon will be destroyed. However, using Red Zen Protection Enhance can prevent this destruction.

notes.title: Black Phantom Class Introduction
notes.content:
I. Introduction 

The Black Phantom, a force to be reckoned with in MU Legend, originates from the depths of shadows and embodies death and mystery. Harnessing the power of darkness, they silently approach enemies on the battlefield, delivering fatal blows with lethal precision. 

The class background of the Black Phantom in MU Legend revolves around themes of mystery, shadow, and death. This class draws from an ancient and powerful shadow force closely linked to death, dreams, and stealth. In the vast world of MU Legend, Black Phantoms are those with a deep connection to the shadow world. They may have once been soldiers, wizards, or other classes. After enduring life and death, pain and betrayal, they formed a contract with the mysterious forces of the shadows, gaining abilities that surpass those of ordinary people. 

Black Phantoms are regarded as ominous by the world, their appearance often signaling disaster and death. However, in their own minds, they are merely pursuing power and freedom, striving to change their fate by mastering the power of shadows. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/80b342701d6c7368c672774634e464b5e4324351.png[/img]
1. The Call of the Shadow World 

Black Phantoms are drawn to the power of the shadow world, which grants them potent shadow mana and stealth abilities. They can freely move in darkness, silently approaching enemies to deliver fatal blows. They also possess the ability to absorb the essence of their foes, converting it into strength to make themselves even more formidable. 

2. Revenge and Redemption 

The stories of Black Phantoms are often steeped in themes of revenge and redemption. They may have been betrayed, framed, or treated unjustly, fueling their anger and hatred toward the world. However, in their quest for power, they gradually realize that revenge cannot bring true liberation. They begin to seek a path of redemption, attempting to protect the innocent with their strength or atone for past mistakes. 

3. Watchers in the Dark 

Though feared and rejected by society, Black Phantoms become watchers in the shadow world. They guard forgotten corners and protect those who cannot defend themselves. In the darkness, they use their power to maintain a delicate balance, ensuring that the shadow world does not excessively encroach upon the real world. 

II. Class Background of the Black Phantom 

1. Shadow Stealth: The Black Phantom excels in stealth, allowing them to approach enemies undetected. 

2. High Explosive Damage: Once within attack range, the Black Phantom can unleash powerful dark energy, inflicting significant damage. 

3. Strong Survivability: They are adept at using shadows to dodge and hide, giving them high survivability in battle. 

III. Skills Overview 

1. Shadow Step: Quickly moves to the target and launches a surprise attack. 

2. Dark Energy: Releases dark energy, dealing additional attack damage. 

3. Mana Explosion: Consumes all essence to detonate mana crystals, causing explosive damage to surrounding enemies. 

4. Essence Shield: Enters a shadow state, increasing evasion rate and movement speed while reducing the enemy's hit rate. Creates a shield to block enemy attacks. 

5. Soul Absorption: Absorbs the souls of all enemies in front, dealing attack damage and gaining 1 essence. 

IV. Equipment and Attributes 

Black Phantoms typically equip weapons and armor with shadow attributes, enhancing their shadow abilities and survivability. In terms of attributes, they prioritize agility, intelligence, and stamina to maximize their stealth, burst damage, and survivability. 

V. Class Role 

Black Phantoms usually serve as assassins or guerrillas within a team. They can deliver fatal blows to enemies at critical moments, creating advantages for their team. Additionally, their stealth abilities allow them to conduct reconnaissance and harassment, providing valuable intelligence support to their allies.

notes.title: Lurie's Secret Vault
notes.content:
Enter Lurie's Secret Vault, defeat the monsters, and earn valuable rewards! 

Gold is a basic currency in MU Legend: EVO, which is essential for shopping and crafting items. You can acquire a significant amount of gold in Lurie's Secret Vault, a hidden treasure trove filled with Lurie's immense wealth. Besides gold, you can also find various valuable items in the vault. 

Given the versatility of gold, it's beneficial to gather as much as possible. Once you reach level 65, you can enter Lurie's Secret Vault, so make sure to visit it daily. Defeat the monsters, destroy obstacles to collect gold, and conquer various foes on your journey to face the final boss, Woblin. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/b4bfdcdb3ec206f994034d63c70ef21733502fb0.png[/img]
This is a dungeon where you can get a lot of gold. 

Lurie's Secret Vault, accessible at level 65, is a special dungeon where you can gather vast amounts of gold. Gold is the basic currency in the game, used to purchase items in shops, craft items through NPCs, and engage in various other game systems. While you can earn gold by completing tasks, hunting monsters, and selling items, the fastest way to amass gold is by venturing into Lurie's Secret Vault. 

True to her greedy reputation, Lurie hid all her treasures in this secret vault, which is now overflowing with gold and other valuable items! However, you can only enter once a day, so make sure to visit this must-see dungeon daily to maximize your gold collection. 

The entrance to the vault is located in the workshop in Ordo. When entering, you can set the difficulty level from 1 to 5. Inside, you'll encounter all kinds of traps, so be very careful as you navigate through the vault. The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards, but be warned: the enemies and traps will become much stronger. Proceed with caution! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/aa97df68d21ffda85945e2661b98c9ed8c69fca2.png[/img]
The higher the difficulty, the stronger the monsters. 

After entering, you'll find yourself in an old hall covered with cobwebs, filled with statues adorned with gold and treasure boxes. As you destroy these statues and treasure boxes, gold will spill out, and you'll need to collect it throughout the entire dungeon. Don’t hesitate to smash everything in sight—destroying objects is key! 

Since this dungeon is accessible only once a day, make sure to defeat all monsters along the way, thoroughly search every corner, and destroy every statue and treasure box. As you defeat monsters, your Terenta gauge will gradually fill. Once it's fully charged, you can activate Terenta to open a portal to the boss room. 

Teleporting through the portal will take you to the BOSS area, where you'll face Woblin. Defeat Woblin to claim the final reward! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/3ddfa966a8fd85867c88a52e0e1829a3f498be92.png[/img]
You can go to the BOSS area by activating the charged Terenta. 

Woblin is the BOSS of Lurie's Secret Vault. Though he may not be an elf, don't let that fool you—his attack power is formidable. Underestimating him could make your battle much more difficult. 

After clearing the vault, you'll receive a ranking based on your performance. You will also have the opportunity to choose a random item card, allowing you to earn extra rewards. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/971962135d99a59e11ea3ed67b7932f955145972.png[/img]
In the end, BOSS Woblin 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/e49859a285ad5ad87a77948aa4031a389d6297b4.png[/img]
Random Rewards

notes.title: Spellbinder
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/23b5933c15d7f9e96129a7474f58c51912ff2c2e.png[/img]
Spellbinder utilizes buffs, debuffs, and ranged attacks to play an auxiliary role in battle. She controls the chain blade and Chakram with her spiritual strength, using various support skills to dominate the battlefield. This article outlines some essential skills of Spellbinder from low level to level 65. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/61fc768f76cf2ead33cabd7eff538dec81427a20.jpg[/img]
▲ Spellbinder is easily recognizable in towns.  

[b]■ Spellbinder: The Auxiliary Character  [/b]

Spellbinder is the second female character in MU Legend and serves as an auxiliary mage. She uses her powerful spiritual power to attack enemies, provide buffs and debuffs, and control AOE groups. Unusually, she wears horns instead of a helmet and stands out with her beautiful costumes. 

Her potent offensive capabilities and useful support skills make her a versatile figure, though mastering her control can be challenging. While her primary role is to strengthen teammates and weaken enemies, she can also excel in 1v1 and multiplayer battles. This makes her suitable for both team-oriented and solo players. 

Players can choose between the two-handed Chakram and the one-handed chain blade, both of which have long ranges. The chain blade increases attack speed by 5%, while the Chakram reduces the enemy's armor value by 10% for 5 seconds with each hit. 

Most of Spellbinder's skills involve setting enchantments over a large area, providing buffs to allies and debuffs to enemies. Although these skills don’t restore player status instantly like the Dark Lord's, they offer significant advantages in combat combinations. 

Spellbinder is also the first character with strong group control abilities, capable of altering the enemy's form. Despite her low defense, her mobility and invincibility skills enhance her survival chances in battle.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/ac8a5577048e675a64078cea18b1025a14599973.jpg[/img]
▲ Chain Blade (Left) and Chakram (Right) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/dd794869291e56663bc4af7a2c4fcbad3635e689.jpg[/img]
▲ Wide-Range Control Skills 

[b]■ Recommended Skill Set[/b]

[h3] ● Suggested Priority Skills [/h3]
- First Place: Counterattack Enchant/Guardian Enchant 
- Second Place: Ladder of Light/Illusion/Time Boundary 
- Third Place: Call of Hope/Withered Flowers/Storm Shuriken 
- Other Skills 
Flower of Wrath, Time Boundary (Chain Blade), Life Boundary (Chain Blade), Illusion Fury (Chain Blade) 
Mental Breakdown (Chain Blade), Pickaxe (Chain Blade), Dream Rain (Chain Blade) 
Telecontrol Storm (Chakram), Wheel Blade (Chakram), Magic Door (Chakram) 
At level 65, players may prefer chain blades over Chakrams due to the higher damage potential with one-handed weapons and the advantage of faster attack speed. For chain blade enthusiasts, "Chain Blade Deployment" and "Ghost Chain Blade" are recommended. For Chakram enthusiasts, "Rotating Blade" is a good option. 

The "Counterattack Enchant" and "Protection Enchant" are used to buff the caster and allies. "Counterattack Enchant" increases attack power by 10% and reduces the enemy's attack power by 10%. "Protection Enchant" provides immunity to damage for 1.5 seconds, reduces ally damage received by 10%, and reduces enemy defense by 20%. These skills are valuable in both single-player and team games.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/0da9914a1b2c548ee7c56d473429a90305485593.jpg[/img]
▲ Counterattack Enchant: Improves Attack Power  

Besides, enchant skills, movement skills like "Ladder of Light" and "Illusion" are crucial. "Ladder of Light" causes continuous damage to surrounding enemies for 8 seconds, increases movement speed by 50%, and ignores collisions, making dungeon clearing faster. "Illusion" instantly teleports the character and increases allies' movement speed by 8%, mainly to avoid enemy attacks. 

"Time Enchant" is a high-level skill that stops all abnormal influences around the caster, improves movement speed, deals 12.75% damage, and reduces enemy movement speed by 90%.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/d5f91aa0c4fb0ec290279906ec337b878ee86355.jpg[/img]
▲ Illusion: Teleport Skills 

"Call of Hope" releases hope energy around the caster, stunning enemies for 1.5 seconds and dealing a strong AOE attack. It is useful for escaping and defeating enemies. 

"Withered Flowers" and "Storm Shuriken" are effective attack skills. "Withered Flowers" causes AOE damage, and "Storm Shuriken," a basic skill, has no cooldown and low MP cost, making it ideal for frequent use. 

Additional skills like Flower of Wrath, Pickaxe, Despair Guide, Dream Rain, Magic Door, Telecontrol Storm, and War Wheel Blade can be used for attacks, while Life Enchant restores HP.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/d5657c6bdced6ebb7c7df532cbf9447285c69e13.jpg[/img]
▲ Attack Skill Preferences 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/793462072acf7ed78f5663924ed251d1794cffa9.jpg[/img]
▲ Storm Shuriken: No Cooldown  

[b]How to combine the passive expert skills of Spellbinder? 
● Suggested Priority Passive Skills [/b]
1. Prayer in the Sky/Hopeful Will 
2. Time Warp/Mental Stimulation/Essence Absorption 
"Prayer in the Sky" and "Hopeful Will" are two key passive skills for the level 65 Spellbinder. The next category includes "Essence Absorption," "Time Distortion," and "Mental Stimulation." 
"Prayer in the Sky" increases the duration of all obstacles by 20% and can be obtained at level 45. 
"Hopeful Will", obtainable at level 65, reduces the cooldown of all obstacle skills by 1 second. 
Since Spellbinder's auxiliary skills are highly effective in combat, enhancing these skills is crucial.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/74376f736f6e601c0f63f81018a6519b63be6097.png[/img]
▲ Two Main Passive Skills 

Additionally, "Time Warp," available at level 45, increases movement speed by 3% when the character's HP exceeds 80%. This skill is useful if all enemies are eliminated before they get too close, but it may be less effective if the equipment or character does not meet appropriate standards. 

"Essence Absorption," obtainable at level 25, can restore up to 5% of the caster's HP when critically attacking the enemy. This skill is very effective when used with an artifact that enhances critical strike ability. However, if the character cannot land critical hits, the effectiveness of this skill will be reduced. 

"Spiritual Stimulation" deals 30% additional damage to enemies whose remaining HP is less than or equal to 30%.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/cbab28553e4d9e142b8c3a95856c53e5526316af.jpg[/img]
▲ Use "Spiritual Stimulation" in Combat

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138771/04564d1fb769c8242131b0ea1ea1ea552db39b6d.jpg[/img]
Dear Players, 

We are excited to announce that the Steam Store page for MU Legend: Evo is officially live as of today, Thursday, August 8, 2024! 

MU Legend: Evo is a dark MMORPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game) where players step into an expansive game world, exploring, battling, and growing alongside others. Building on the dark magic aesthetic of MU Legend, this new installment introduces a world brimming with mystery and fantasy. It features ultra-fast combat, animated 3D visual effects, and a continuously expanding world. 

In addition to retaining the classic gameplay of MU Legend, MU Legend: Evo introduces new gameplay mechanics such as AFK, Talent Points, the Soul Box, and the Talisman System, giving players greater freedom in character creation. 

MU Legend: Evo also boasts significant improvements in art, with more detailed character models, enhanced light and shadow effects, and more realistic scene rendering compared to MU Legend. 

The MU Legend: Evo Operations Team
